caption_L1: Here a is a bar plot labeled Index of most water-efficient U.S. and Canadian cities in 2010. The x-axis plots City using categorical scale with Boston on one end and Vancouver at the other while the y-axis plots Score with linear scale of range 0 to 100.
caption_L2L3: Calgary is the most water-efficient city. Toronto is the least water efficient city. Boston and Calgary are the only cities with a water efficiency higher than 90. Every city has a water efficiency higher than 80.
